note: Ratchet: this list drains, never grows. `live` is a fully-qualified Lean name declared in BOTH a content-block `.lean` sibling and the library, WHERE the block's own `lean.ref` names that exact FQN -- so every per-block checker (`q-usage-*`, `wall-side-correct`, `proof-statement-integrity`, the `da-*` family) reads the sibling and never sees the declaration `lake build` compiles.
not_every_live_entry_is_a_defect: A FAITHFUL live mirror is working as designed: AGENTS.md 4a gates DRIFT, not mirroring, and a `definition` block is REQUIRED to carry a sibling (3). Deleting a faithful mirror would break that requirement. The actionable subset is `live_drifted`.
direction_is_not_uniform: Do not assume the library is canonical. Measured across the 163 substantive drifts: 91 have the library side edited more recently, 70 the sibling side. Recency is not canonicality -- `QOU.Information.speedOfLight` has the LIBRARY edited later and the SIBLING is the 7c-compliant one (generic base ring, division-free, defining relation discharged as a theorem). Every reconciliation requires reading both sides.
